name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – § 62 – Am 66/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 62. Rejects a scenario in which EU funds contribute to perpetuating or deepening dependences on non-European actors, both for production of capabilities or their deployment; calls, therefore, on the Commission and the Member States to ensure that EU public spending goes to EU companies, and EU companies only; stresses that the licensed production of US weapons should not be counted as European production, eligible for EU spending;
